verdict.rationale: Filee is a document and file converter, so safe handling of untrusted macros and scripts is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only offline, no-upload processing and conversion without Microsoft Office. That is a privacy property, not a statement that embedded macros or scripts are parsed as content and never executed. Nothing in the pack addresses macro or script execution, sandboxing, or untrusted-input handling.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the converter treats untrusted input safely: scripts and macros are read as content, never executed
